name: objects-body
text:
Schedule:  m_ij = mu + a_i + b_j + h_ij

Firm dispersion:  Q_F = E_i Var_j(m_ij)

Contrast heterogeneity:  H_F = E_jk Var_i(m_ik - m_ij)

Assignment:  C_assign^w = 1/2[Var_obs(m) - Var_prod(m)]
